blind.description: A stylized fantasy/cartoon blacksmith's anvil made of dark forged iron resting atop a round cut-log wooden stump. The stump is banded with a dark iron strap around the middle and features carved vertical wood grain. The anvil has a rounded conical horn, a flat striking face with a square hardy hole, curved waist, and flared mounting feet firmly resting on the wood. Geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with no floating, melted, or disjointed elements.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a circular textured wooden disc with an elongated dark grey anvil running vertically across its center, featuring a pointed horn at the lower end and a rectangular heel with a square hole at the upper end.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: wooden log stump serving as an integral stand
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly waist-high or slightly below half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and approximately 2 feet in diameter at the base.
